Big Deal or No Deal
03 Apr 2015: How Iran sanctions relief might impact the tanker market. Yesterday, the P5+1 and Iran announced that they had reached a framework agreement on the containment of Iran’s nuclear program in exchange for the gradual lifting of sanctions, the details of which will need to be completed by June 30th.
